text_en: Now a scoundrel named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjaminite, happened to be there. He sounded the trumpet and cried out, “We have no portion in David, no share in the son of Jesse! Everyone to your tents, O Israel! ”
text_cn: 当时，在那里有个败类，名叫舍巴，是本雅明人彼革黎的儿子。他吹着号，喊说：“我们和达味没有关系，对叶瑟儿子的产业没有分子。以色列人！各自回本家吧！”

text_en: So all the people of Israel withdrew from David and followed Sheba son of Bichri; but the people of Judah followed their king steadfastly from the Jordan to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 因此，众以色列人离开达味，跟随了彼革黎的儿子舍巴；但犹大人仍然紧随他们的君王，由约但河直到了耶路撒冷。

text_en: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten concubines whom he had left to look after the house, and put them in a house under guard, and provided for them, but did not go in to them. So they were shut up until the day of their death, living as if in widowhood.
text_cn: 达味王进了耶路撒冷的宫殿，就将他留下看守宫殿的十个嫔妃，留在禁宫里，养活她们，却不再亲近她们。她们被禁在冷宫内，一直到死，终身守寡。

text_en: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call the men of Judah together to me within three days, and be here yourself. ”
text_cn: 王对阿玛撒说：“三天之内，你应给我召集犹大人，你亲自也该来到这里。”

text_en: So Amasa went to summon Judah; but he delayed beyond the set time that had been appointed him.
text_cn: 阿玛撒去召集犹大人，但他迟延耽搁，过了君王给他所定的期限。

text_en: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom; take your lord’s servants and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities for himself, and escape from us. ”
text_cn: 达味就对阿彼瑟说：“现今彼革黎的儿子舍巴危害我们，恐怕甚于阿贝沙隆。你快领你主人的军队去追赶他，免得他占了设防的城，由我们眼前逃脱。”

text_en: Joab’s men went out after him, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the warriors; they went out from Jerusalem to pursue Sheba son of Bichri.
text_cn: 约阿布的部下，革勒提人和培肋提人，以及所有的勇士，都跟阿彼瑟去了。他们由耶路撒冷出发，追赶彼革黎的儿子舍巴。

text_en: When they were at the large stone that is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Now Joab was wearing a soldier’s garment and over it was a belt with a sword in its sheath fastened at his waist; as he went forward it fell out.
text_cn: 当他们来到基贝红的大石旁时，阿玛撒也迎面而来。约阿布身穿战袍，束着腰带，腰间挂着一把带鞘的刀。约阿布的刀出鞘落地。

text_en: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother? ” And Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
text_cn: 约阿布对阿玛撒说：“吾兄，你好？”约阿布遂用右手抓住阿玛撒的胡须，与他亲吻。

text_en: But Amasa did not notice the sword in Joab’s hand; Joab struck him in the belly so that his entrails poured out on the ground, and he died. He did not strike a second blow. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bichri.
text_cn: 阿玛撒没有提防约阿布手中的刀；约阿布就用刀刺穿了他的肚腹，五脏倾流地上，没有再刺第二下，他就死了。约阿布与自己的兄弟阿彼瑟，便往前追赶彼革黎的儿子舍巴。

text_en: And one of Joab’s men took his stand by Amasa, and said, “Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab. ”
text_cn: 看守阿玛撒尸首的约阿布的一个兵士喊说：“谁喜爱约阿布，谁属达味，就跟约阿布去！”

text_en: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood on the highway, and the man saw that all the people were stopping. Since he saw that all who came by him were stopping, he carried Amasa from the highway into a field, and threw a garment over him.
text_cn: 阿玛撒此时卧在路中血泊中，那人见众人停留不前，就将阿玛撒的尸首，由路上搬到田里，上面盖上一件衣服，因为他见军人到了那里，就停在尸首前。

text_en: Once he was removed from the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bichri.
text_cn: 尸首由路上搬走后，军人就都过去，跟随约阿布追赶彼革黎的儿子舍巴。

text_en: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel of Beth-maacah; and all the Bichrites assembled, and followed him inside.
text_cn: 舍巴走遍了以色列各支派，人都不理他。随后到了贝特玛阿加的阿贝耳，众彼革黎人却聚集起来，跟随了他。

text_en: Joab’s forces came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maacah; they threw up a siege ramp against the city, and it stood against the rampart. Joab’s forces were battering the wall to break it down.
text_cn: 约阿布大军前来，把他包围在贝特玛阿加的阿贝耳内，兴筑攻城壁垒。跟随约阿布的大军遂下手挖城墙，使墙倒塌。

text_en: Then a wise woman called from the city, “Listen! Listen! Tell Joab, ‘Come here, I want to speak to you. ’”
text_cn: 当时城中有个聪明的妇人站在城墙上喊说：“请听！请听！你们对约阿布说：来这里，我有话对你说。”

text_en: He came near her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab? ” He answered, “I am. ” Then she said to him, “Listen to the words of your servant. ” He answered, “I am listening. ”
text_cn: 约阿布来到她那里，妇人便问说：“你是约阿布吗？”他答说：“我是。”她便对他说：“请你听你婢女一言！”他答说：“我听。”

text_en: Then she said, “They used to say in the old days, ‘Let them inquire at Abel’; and so they would settle a matter.
text_cn: 她说：“从前有句话说：你去问问阿贝耳，事便可得解决。

text_en: I am one of those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel; you seek to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel; why will you swallow up the heritage of the Lord ? ”
text_cn: 我在以色列算是一座和平忠厚的城，你却图谋消灭一座以色列的母城。为什么你要吞灭上主的产业？”

text_en: Joab answered, “Far be it from me, far be it, that I should swallow up or destroy!
text_cn: 约阿布答说：“决无此事，我决无意消灭或破坏。

text_en: That is not the case! But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, called Sheba son of Bichri, has lifted up his hand against King David; give him up alone, and I will withdraw from the city. ” The woman said to Joab, “His head shall be thrown over the wall to you. ”
text_cn: 完全不是这么一回事；只因厄弗辣因山地的一人，即彼革黎的儿子名叫舍巴的，造反抗拒达味王；只要你们将他交出来，我即撤离这城。”妇人对约阿布说：“请看，他的头由城墙上抛给你。”

text_en: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise plan. And they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. So he blew the trumpet, and they dispersed from the city, and all went to their homes, while Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
text_cn: 妇人就去凭自己的智慧劝说众百姓。他们便砍了彼革黎的儿子舍巴的头，抛给约阿布。约阿布遂吹起号角，撤兵离城，各自回了本家。约阿布也回了耶路撒冷君王那里。

text_en: Now Joab was in command of all the army of Israel; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in command of the Cherethites and the Pelethites;
text_cn: 约阿布统率以色列的众军队；约雅达的儿子贝纳雅管理革勒提人和培肋提人；

text_en: Adoram was in charge of the forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
text_cn: 阿多兰管理奴役；阿希路得的儿子约沙法特作御史；

text_en: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
text_cn: 史沙作书记；匝多克和厄贝雅塔尔作司祭；

text_en: and Ira the Jairite was also David’s priest.
text_cn: 此外，雅提尔人依辣也作达味的司祭。
